name: marine-hv-simulator-3d
description: Marine HV 6.6 kV Switchboard — 3D Digital Twin, Switching & Permit-to-Work Simulator

scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { for (const f of ['index.html', 'server.js', 'game/navigation.js', 'game/room.js', 'game/character.js', 'game/controller.js', 'game/game.css', 'design-system/fonts.css', 'design-system/tokens.css', 'design-system/components.css']) { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error('Missing required file: ' + f); } console.log('All static & game modules verified.'); })"
scripts.lint: node --check server.js && node --check game/navigation.js && node --check game/room.js && node --check game/character.js && node --check game/controller.js
